metadata.title: Hypothetical clinical trial matching
metadata.source: Hypothetical trial of an educational program for adults with migraine. The requirements are invented for this teaching example.

criteria.statement: The patient is at least 18 years old on the assessment date. The assessment date is the date used to evaluate the potential match.
The patient has a clinician-confirmed diagnosis of migraine.
The patient is receiving an intervention as part of another migraine trial on the assessment date. Unknown participation leaves this criterion unresolved.

expressions.description: The patient meets the stated criteria for research-team review. The research team confirms eligibility and manages informed consent and enrollment.
